# rusty_paserk

Source: https://github.com/conradludgate/rusty-paserk/blob/main/README.md

# rusty_paserk

![CI status](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/conradludgate/rusty-paserk/rust.yml?style=for-the-badge)

An extension of [`rusty_paseto`](https://github.com/rrrodzilla/rusty_paseto) adding the [Platform Agnostic Serializable Keys](https://github.com/paseto-standard/paserk) specifications on top.

## Examples

Examples can be found on [docs.rs](https://docs.rs/rusty_paserk) online, or in the `src/lib.rs` file.

# Security Policy

Source: https://github.com/conradludgate/rusty-paserk/blob/main/SECURITY.md

# Security Policy

This crate has NOT been independently audited.  As with any code you find on the web that has not been audited, usage of this crate is at your own risk.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report any issues to the maintainer by creating a bug report. Thank you for your contribution!
